Class GitHubTokenProviderResult

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.rpc.GitHubTokenProviderResult
public final class GitHubTokenProviderResult extends Object
Result of acquiring a session-scoped GitHub token.

Token values are redacted from toString().

1.0.0

      public static GitHubTokenProviderResult token(String accessToken, long expiresIn, String tokenType)
      Creates a token result with an explicit OAuth token type.
      Parameters:
      accessToken - GitHub access token
      expiresIn - positive remaining lifetime in seconds when the callback completes
      tokenType - OAuth token type, or null to use the runtime's bearer default

      the token result
